videos.title: eChessGw Demo
videos.description:
eChessGw ist ein DIY-Projekt. Alle Informationen dazu findest du hier:
https://github.com/parlue/eChessGw

Bei Fragen kannst du mich gerne kontaktieren.

----
eChessGw is a wireless connector for electronic chessboards and cable-based chess computers such as the Millennium Phoenix.

It can also store PGN files and provides easy access to them through Chessnut emulation.

eChessGw is a DIY project, and all information is available here:
https://github.com/parlue/eChessGw

Feel free to contact me if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Dirk
